newsitem.title: USA: AOL launches instant messaging for the Net.
newsitem.headline: AOL launches instant messaging for the Net.

text.p: America Online Inc said Thursday that it is offering its "instant messaging" software, previously available only to AOL users, to all Internet users, free by downloading the software at its Web site.
The software, which is currently in beta, or customer testing, lets users send and respond to messages immediately while a "Buddy List" feature tells users who among their friends is online.
AOL said that the software, which runs on the Internet backbone and not on AOLNet, AOL's proprietary network, can handle millions of simultaneous users.
